```{r}
library(plyr)
library(lattice)
library(aod)
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)

library(geepack)
library(gridExtra)
library(grid)
library(cowplot)
library(lme4)

#load data (note: data needs to be uploaded to the desktop for this to work)
study1a_data <- read_excel("~/Desktop/study1a_data_clean.xlsx")
study1b_data <- read_excel("~/Desktop/study1b_data_clean.xlsx")
study2_data <- read_excel("~/Desktop/study2_data_clean.xlsx")
study3_data <- read_excel("~/Desktop/study3_data_clean.xlsx")

study5_data <- read_excel("~/Desktop/study5_data_clean.xlsx")

```


#Study 1: Non-Voluntary Positive and Negative Reciprocity

## Cleaning Data

Reshaping giving condition data:
```{r}

#reshape study 1a data into long format
study1a_data_long <- reshape(study1a_data, 
varying = c("Initial_Trial_Direct_Reciprocity",
            "Initial_Trial_GaveToSameSide",
            "Initial_Trial_MemCheck_Receiving_Correct",
            "Initial_Trial_MemCheck_Giving_Correct",
            "InGroup_Trial_Direct_Reciprocity",
            "InGroup_Trial_Group_Reciprocity",
            "InGroup_Trial_MemCheck_Receiving_Correct",
            "InGroup_Trial_MemCheck_Giving_Correct",
            "OutGroup_Trial_Direct_Reciprocity",
            "OutGroup_Trial_Group_Reciprocity",
            "OutGroup_Trial_MemCheck_Receiving_Correct",
            "OutGroup_Trial_MemCheck_Giving_Correct",
            "Perceptual_Control_Trial_Direct_Reciprocity",
            "Perceptual_Control_Trial_Group_Reciprocity",
            "Perceptual_Control_Trial_MemCheck_Receiving_Correct",
            "Perceptual_Control_Trial_MemCheck_Giving_Correct"),
v.names = c("1_Direct Reciprocity","2_Group Reciprocity","3_Memory Check Receiving Q Correct","4_Memory Check Giving Q Correct"),
timevar="Trial Type",
times = c("Initial Trial","In Group Trial","Out Group Trial","Perceptual Control Trial"),
new.row.names = 1:800,
direction = "long")

#adding a column to denote whether children gave to the in-group
study1a_data_long$Gave_To_InGroup <- NA
study1a_data_long$Gave_To_InGroup[study1a_data_long$`Trial Type` == "In Group Trial" & study1a_data_long$`2_Group Reciprocity`==1] <- 1
study1a_data_long$Gave_To_InGroup[study1a_data_long$`Trial Type` == "In Group Trial" & study1a_data_long$`2_Group Reciprocity`==0] <- 0
study1a_data_long$Gave_To_InGroup[study1a_data_long$`Trial Type` == "Out Group Trial" & study1a_data_long$`2_Group Reciprocity`==1] <- 0
study1a_data_long$Gave_To_InGroup[study1a_data_long$`Trial Type` == "Out Group Trial" & study1a_data_long$`2_Group Reciprocity`==0] <- 1

#deleting group information (there is no group info) from the initial trial
study1a_data_long$`2_Group Reciprocity`[study1a_data_long$`Trial Type` == 'Initial Trial'] <- NA
```

Reshaping stealing condition data:
```{r}

#reshape study 1b data
study1b_data_long <- reshape(study1b_data, 
varying = c("Initial_Trial_Direct_Reciprocity",
            "Initial_Trial_GaveToSameSide",
            "Initial_Trial_MemCheck_Receiving_Correct",
            "Initial_Trial_MemCheck_Giving_Correct",
            "InGroup_Trial_Direct_Reciprocity",
            "InGroup_Trial_Group_Reciprocity",
            "InGroup_Trial_MemCheck_Receiving_Correct",
            "InGroup_Trial_MemCheck_Giving_Correct",
            "OutGroup_Trial_Direct_Reciprocity",
            "OutGroup_Trial_Group_Reciprocity",
            "OutGroup_Trial_MemCheck_Receiving_Correct",
            "OutGroup_Trial_MemCheck_Giving_Correct",
            "Perceptual_Control_Trial_Direct_Reciprocity",
            "Perceptual_Control_Trial_Group_Reciprocity",
            "Perceptual_Control_Trial_MemCheck_Receiving_Correct",
            "Perceptual_Control_Trial_MemCheck_Giving_Correct"),
v.names = c("1_Direct Reciprocity","2_Group Reciprocity","3_Memory Check Receiving Q Correct","4_Memory Check Giving Q Correct"),
timevar="Trial Type",
times = c("Initial Trial","In Group Trial","Out Group Trial","Perceptual Control Trial"),
new.row.names = 1:800,
direction = "long")

#adding a column to denote whether children gave to the in-group
study1b_data_long$Gave_To_InGroup <- NA
study1b_data_long$Gave_To_InGroup[study1b_data_long$`Trial Type` == "In Group Trial" & study1b_data_long$`2_Group Reciprocity`==1] <- 1
study1b_data_long$Gave_To_InGroup[study1b_data_long$`Trial Type` == "In Group Trial" & study1b_data_long$`2_Group Reciprocity`==0] <- 0
study1b_data_long$Gave_To_InGroup[study1b_data_long$`Trial Type` == "Out Group Trial" & study1b_data_long$`2_Group Reciprocity`==1] <- 0
study1b_data_long$Gave_To_InGroup[study1b_data_long$`Trial Type` == "Out Group Trial" & study1b_data_long$`2_Group Reciprocity`==0] <- 1

#deleting group information (there is no group info) from the initial trial
study1b_data_long$`2_Group Reciprocity`[study1b_data_long$`Trial Type` == 'Baseline Trial'] <- NA

```

Combining two conditions into one sheet:
```{r}

#making sure there are no redundant Subject IDs in Studies 1a and 1b merged:
study1a_data_long$`Subject ID` <- study1a_data_long$`Subject ID`+200
study1b_data_long$`Subject ID` <- study1b_data_long$`Subject ID`+300

study1a_data$`Subject ID` <- study1a_data$`Subject ID`+200
study1b_data$`Subject ID` <- study1b_data$`Subject ID`+300

#adding a column denoting study
study1a_data_long$Condition <- "Giving"
study1b_data_long$Condition <-"Stealing"

#merging two files
study1_data <- rbind(study1a_data,study1b_data)
study1_data_long <- rbind(study1a_data_long,study1b_data_long)
```

```{r}
#descriptive analyses
study1_mean_age <- mean(study1_data$Age)

study1_max_age <- max(study1_data$Age)

study1_gender <- data.frame(table(study1_data$Gender))
```

## Direct Reciprocity

We first investigated factors that impact direct reciprocity:

```{r}

m1.study1 <- glmer(`1_Direct Reciprocity` ~ 
                   Age+
                   relevel(factor(`Trial Type`),"Initial Trial")+ 
                   Condition+
                   (1|`Subject ID`),
                 study1_data_long,
                 family="binomial")

#printing tables
summary(m1.study1)
kable(tidy(m1.study1,digits=3))
m1.study1.overall <-Anova(m1.study1)
kable(m1.study1.overall,digits=3)

```

We then compared direct reciprocity to chance for each trial:

```{r}
#Running the binomial tests:

#Initial Trial: Giving
study1.initial.trial.giving <- binom.test(
  length(which(study1a_data$Initial_Trial_Direct_Reciprocity==1)),
  length(which(study1a_data$Initial_Trial_Direct_Reciprocity<2)),p=.25)

#Baseline Trial: Stealing
study1.initial.trial.stealing <- binom.test(
  length(which(study1b_data$Initial_Trial_Direct_Reciprocity==1)),
  length(which(study1b_data$Initial_Trial_Direct_Reciprocity<2)),p=.25)

#In Group Trial: Giving
study1.ingroup.trial.giving <- binom.test(
  length(which(study1a_data$InGroup_Trial_Direct_Reciprocity==1)),
  length(which(study1a_data$InGroup_Trial_Direct_Reciprocity<2)),p=.25)

#In Group Trial: Stealing
study1.ingroup.trial.stealing <- binom.test(length(
  which(study1b_data$InGroup_Trial_Direct_Reciprocity==1)),
  length(which(study1b_data$InGroup_Trial_Direct_Reciprocity<2)),p=.25)

#Out Group Trial: Giving
study1.outgroup.trial.giving <- binom.test(
  length(which(study1a_data$OutGroup_Trial_Direct_Reciprocity==1)),
  length(which(study1a_data$OutGroup_Trial_Direct_Reciprocity<2)),p=.25)

#Out Group Trial: Stealing
study1.outgroup.trial.stealing <- binom.test(
  length(which(study1b_data$OutGroup_Trial_Direct_Reciprocity==1)),
  length(which(study1b_data$OutGroup_Trial_Direct_Reciprocity<2)),p=.25)

#Perceptual Similarity Control Trial: Giving
study1.perceptcntrl.trial.giving <- binom.test(
  length(which(study1a_data$Perceptual_Control_Trial_Direct_Reciprocity==1)),
  length(which(study1a_data$Perceptual_Control_Trial_Direct_Reciprocity<2)),p=.25)

#Perceptual Similarity Control Trial: Stealing
study1.perceptcntrl.trial.stealing <- binom.test(
  length(which(study1b_data$Perceptual_Control_Trial_Direct_Reciprocity==1)),
  length(which(study1b_data$Perceptual_Control_Trial_Direct_Reciprocity<2)),p=.25)

#Overall binomial: Giving
study1.overall.giving <-binom.test(
  length(which(study1a_data_long$`1_Direct Reciprocity`==1)),
  length(which(study1a_data_long$`1_Direct Reciprocity`<2)),p=.25)

#Overall binomial: Stealing
study1.overall.stealing <-binom.test(
  length(which(study1b_data_long$`1_Direct Reciprocity`==1)),
  length(which(study1b_data_long$`1_Direct Reciprocity`<2)),p=.25)


#Printing Tables of Binomial Tests
study1.initial.trial.giving.1 <- tidy(study1.initial.trial.giving,digits=3)
study1.initial.trial.giving.1$test <- "initial trial, giving - direct reciprocity"
study1.initial.trial.stealing.1 <- tidy(study1.initial.trial.stealing,digits=3)
study1.initial.trial.stealing.1$test <- "initial trial, stealing - direct reciprocity"
study1.ingroup.trial.giving.1 <- tidy(study1.ingroup.trial.giving,digits=3)
study1.ingroup.trial.giving.1$test <- "ingroup trial, giving - direct reciprocity"
study1.ingroup.trial.stealing.1 <- tidy(study1.ingroup.trial.stealing,digits=3)
study1.ingroup.trial.stealing.1$test <- "ingroup trial, stealing - direct reciprocity"
study1.outgroup.trial.giving.1 <- tidy(study1.outgroup.trial.giving,digits=3)
study1.outgroup.trial.giving.1$test <- "outgroup trial, giving - direct reciprocity"
study1.outgroup.trial.stealing.1 <- tidy(study1.outgroup.trial.stealing,digits=3)
study1.outgroup.trial.stealing.1$test <- "outgroup trial, stealing - direct reciprocity"
study1.perceptcntrl.trial.giving.1 <- tidy(study1.perceptcntrl.trial.giving,digits=3)
study1.perceptcntrl.trial.giving.1$test <- "perceptual control trial, giving - direct reciprocity"
study1.perceptcntrl.trial.stealing.1 <- tidy(study1.perceptcntrl.trial.stealing,digits=3)
study1.perceptcntrl.trial.stealing.1$test <- "perceptual control trial, stealing - direct reciprocity"
study1.overall.giving.1 <- tidy(study1.overall.giving,digits=3)
study1.overall.giving.1$test <- "overall giving"
study1.overall.stealing.1 <- tidy(study1.overall.stealing,digits=3)
study1.overall.stealing.1$test <- "overall stealing"

#binding the table of tests together
study1.total.direct.reciprocity <- rbind(study1.initial.trial.giving.1,
                                             study1.initial.trial.stealing.1,
                                             study1.ingroup.trial.giving.1,
                                             study1.ingroup.trial.stealing.1,
                                             study1.outgroup.trial.giving.1,
                                             study1.outgroup.trial.stealing.1,
                                             study1.perceptcntrl.trial.giving.1,
                                             study1.perceptcntrl.trial.stealing.1,
                                             study1.overall.giving.1,
                                             study1.overall.stealing.1)

#deleting unnecessary information
study1.total.direct.reciprocity$method <- NULL
study1.total.direct.reciprocity$alternative <-NULL

#creating a table of direct reciprocity
study1.direct.reciprocity.table.giving <- tapply(study1a_data_long$`1_Direct Reciprocity`,study1a_data_long$`Trial Type`,mean,na.rm=TRUE)

study1.direct.reciprocity.table.stealing <-tapply(study1b_data_long$`1_Direct Reciprocity`,study1b_data_long$`Trial Type`,mean,na.rm=TRUE)

```



Rates of Negative Direct Reciprocity (Stealing) in Study 1:
```{r}
study1.direct.reciprocity.table.stealing
```

Rates of Positive Direct Reciprocity (Giving) in Study 1:
```{r}
study1.direct.reciprocity.table.giving
```

Binomial Tests of Direct Reciprocity Rates Across Trials & Conditions:
```{r}
kable(study1.total.direct.reciprocity,digits=3)
```

## Memory Check Questions:

Memory Check Questions confirmed that most children remember the benefactor and beneficiary

Overall Memory Check for All Questions:
```{r}
#Overall Giving Question
study1.memcheck.overall.giving <- binom.test(
  length(which(study1_data_long$`4_Memory Check Giving Q Correct`==1)),
  length(which(study1_data_long$`4_Memory Check Giving Q Correct`<2)),p=.25)

#Overall Receiving Question
study1.memcheck.overall.receiving <- binom.test(
  length(which(study1_data_long$`3_Memory Check Receiving Q Correct`==1)),
  length(which(study1_data_long$`3_Memory Check Receiving Q Correct`<2)),p=.25)

#Overall Receiving Question for Giving Condition
study1.memcheck.overall.receiving_giving <-binom.test(
  length(which(study1a_data_long$`3_Memory Check Receiving Q Correct`==1)),
  length(which(study1a_data_long$`3_Memory Check Receiving Q Correct`<2)),p=.25)

#Overall Receiving Question for Stealing Condition
study1.memcheck.overall.receiving_stealing <-binom.test(
  length(which(study1b_data_long$`3_Memory Check Receiving Q Correct`==1)),
  length(which(study1b_data_long$`3_Memory Check Receiving Q Correct`<2)),p=.25)

#Overall Giving Question for Giving Condition
study1.memcheck.overall.giving_giving <-binom.test(
  length(which(study1a_data_long$`4_Memory Check Giving Q Correct`==1)),
  length(which(study1a_data_long$`4_Memory Check Giving Q Correct`<2)),p=.25)

#Overall Giving Question for Stealing Condition
study1.memcheck.overall.giving_stealing <-binom.test(
  length(which(study1b_data_long$`4_Memory Check Giving Q Correct`==1)),
  length(which(study1b_data_long$`4_Memory Check Giving Q Correct`<2)),p=.25)

```

We also checked to make sure that the main model results held even when considering only children who answered both memory check questions correctly:
```{r}

#creating a subset of children with correct responses to memory check questions only
study1_data_long_corrmem <- subset(study1_data_long,
                                   study1_data_long$`3_Memory Check Receiving Q Correct`==1 &
                                     study1_data_long$`4_Memory Check Giving Q Correct`==1)

#re-doing individual reciprocity analysis only with children who correctly recalled benefactors and beneficiaries.
m3.study1 <- update(m1.study1, .~., data=study1_data_long_corrmem,
control=glmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa",optCtrl=list(maxfun=100000)))

#print tables
summary(m3.study1)
kable(tidy(m3.study1,digits=3))
m3.study1.overall <-Anova(m3.study1,test="Chisq")
kable(m3.study1.overall,digits=3)
```

Finally, we checked for condition effects on rates of recall:
```{r}
#receiving question
m4.study1 <-update(m1.study1, study1_data_long$`3_Memory Check Receiving Q Correct`~.)
summary(m4.study1)
m4.study1.overall <- Anova(m4.study1,test="Chisq")
kable(m4.study1.overall)

#giving question
m5.study1 <-update(m1.study1, study1_data_long$`4_Memory Check Giving Q Correct`~.)
summary(m5.study1)
m5.study1.overall <- Anova(m5.study1,test="Chisq")
kable(m5.study1.overall)
```


## Group Reciprocity

```{r}

#In Group Trial: Giving
study1.ingroup.trial.giving.group <- binom.test(
  length(which(study1a_data$InGroup_Trial_Group_Reciprocity==1)),
  length(which(study1a_data$InGroup_Trial_Group_Reciprocity<2)),p=.5)

#In Group Trial: Stealing

  length(which(study1b_data$InGroup_Trial_Group_Reciprocity==1)),
  length(which(study1b_data$InGroup_Trial_Group_Reciprocity<2)),p=.5)

#Out Group Trial: Giving

#Out Group Trial: Stealing

#Perceptual Similarity Control Trial: Giving
study1.perceptualcntrl.trial.giving.group <- binom.test(

  length(which(study1a_data$Perceptual_Control_Trial_Group_Reciprocity<2)),p=.5)

#Perceptual Similarity Control: Stealing
study1.perceptualcntrl.trial.stealing.group <- binom.test(
  length(which(study1b_data$Perceptual_Control_Trial_Group_Reciprocity==1)),
  length(which(study1b_data$Perceptual_Control_Trial_Group_Reciprocity<2)),p=.5)

#Overall binomial
study1.overall.giving.group <-binom.test(
  length(which(study1a_data_long$`2_Group Reciprocity`==1)),

#Printing Tables of Binomial Tests
study1.ingroup.trial.giving.1.group <- tidy(study1.ingroup.trial.giving.group,digits=3)
study1.ingroup.trial.giving.1.group$test <- "ingroup trial, giving - Group reciprocity"
study1.ingroup.trial.stealing.1.group <- tidy(study1.ingroup.trial.stealing.group,digits=3)

study1.perceptualcntrl.trial.giving.1.group <- tidy(study1.perceptualcntrl.trial.giving.group,
                                                    digits=3)
study1.perceptualcntrl.trial.giving.1.group$test <- "perceptual control trial, giving - Group reciprocity"
study1.perceptualcntrl.trial.stealing.1.group <- tidy(study1.perceptualcntrl.trial.stealing.group,
                                                      digits=3)
study1.perceptualcntrl.trial.stealing.1.group$test <- "perceptual control trial, stealing - Group reciprocity"
study1.overall.giving.group <- tidy(study1.overall.giving.group,digits=3)
study1.overall.giving.group$test <- "overall, giving - Group reciprocity"
study1.overall.stealing.group <- tidy(study1.overall.stealing.group,digits=3)
study1.overall.stealing.group$test <- "overall, stealing - Group reciprocity"

study1.total.group.reciprocity <- rbind(study1.ingroup.trial.giving.1.group,
                                        study1.ingroup.trial.stealing.1.group,

study1.groupreciprocity.table.stealing <-tapply(study1b_data_long$`2_Group Reciprocity`,

                                                mean,na.rm=TRUE)
```

## Plots

```{r}

#reordering variables
pos.indiv <- c("Initial Trial", "In Group Trial", "Out Group Trial", "Perceptual Control Trial")
pos.indiv.2 <- c("Initial\nTrial", "In Group\nTrial", "Out Group\nTrial", "Perceptual Similarity\nTrial")
pos.group <- c("In Group Trial", "Out Group Trial", "Perceptual Control Trial")


#creating a table of direct reciprocity rates: giving

study1.direct.recip.table.giving.correct <- tapply(
  study1a_data_long$`1_Direct Reciprocity`,
  study1a_data_long$`Trial Type`,
  mean,
  na.rm=TRUE)

#creating a table of direct reciprocity rates: stealing
study1.direct.recip.table.stealing.correct <-tapply(study1b_data_long$`1_Direct Reciprocity`,
                                                study1b_data_long$`Trial Type`,
                                                mean,
                                                na.rm=TRUE)

study1.direct.recip.table.giving.melted <- melt(study1.direct.recip.table.giving.correct)
study1.direct.recip.table.giving.melted$Condition <- "giving"
study1.direct.recip.table.stealing.melted <- melt(study1.direct.recip.table.stealing.correct)
study1.direct.recip.table.stealing.melted$Condition <- "stealing"

study1.direct.recip.table <- rbind(study1.direct.recip.table.giving.melted,
                                       study1.direct.recip.table.stealing.melted)


#creating a table of group level reciprocity
study1.group.recip.table.giving <-tapply(study1a_data_long$`2_Group Reciprocity`,
                                         study1a_data_long$`Trial Type`,
                                         mean,
                                         na.rm=TRUE)

study1.group.recip.table.stealing <-tapply(study1b_data_long$`2_Group Reciprocity`,
                                           study1b_data_long$`Trial Type`,
                                           mean,
                                           na.rm=TRUE)

#getting rid of the initial trial
study1.group.recip.table.giving$`Initial Trial` <- NULL
study1.group.recip.table.stealing$`Initial Trial` <- NULL

#melting the table
study1.group.recip.table.giving.melted <- melt(study1.group.recip.table.giving)
study1.group.recip.table.giving.melted$Condition <- "giving"
study1.group.recip.table.stealing.melted <- melt(study1.group.recip.table.stealing)
study1.group.recip.table.stealing.melted$Condition <- "stealing"

#combining giving and stealing tables
study1.group.recip.table <- rbind(study1.group.recip.table.giving.melted,
                                  study1.group.recip.table.stealing.melted)


#creating bargraphs

#creating data frame with coordinates
label.sig <- data.frame(Group=c("Initial\nTrial","In Group\nTrial", "Out Group\nTrial", "Perceptual Similarity\nTrial"),
                        Value=c(.5,.5,.5,.5),
                        Label=c("*","**","",""))

#direct reciprocity graph
study1.direct.recip.plot <- ggplot(study1.direct.recip.table, 
                                   aes(x=Var1,y=value,fill=Condition))+
  geom_bar(stat="identity",colour="black",position=position_dodge())+
  theme_minimal(base_family='Helvetica')+
  scale_y_continuous(labels=scales::percent,limits=c(0,1))+
  labs(x="Trial Type",y="Proportion of Children Displaying\nDirect Reciprocity")+
  geom_hline(yintercept=.25,linetype="dashed")+
  scale_x_discrete(limits=pos.indiv, labels=pos.indiv.2)+
  theme(legend.position = "right")+
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("white","gray","white","gray","white","gray","white","gray"))+
  ggtitle("Study 1: Direct Reciprocity")+
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size=12))

#group reciprocity graph
study1.group.recip.plot <- ggplot(study1.group.recip.table,
                                  aes(x=L1,y=value,fill=Condition))+
  geom_bar(stat="identity",colour="black",position=position_dodge())+
  scale_y_continuous(labels=scales::percent,limits=c(0,1))+
  labs(x="Trial Type",y="Proportion of Children Displaying\nGroup-Based Reciprocity")+
  ggtitle("Study 1: Group Reciprocity")+
  geom_hline(yintercept=.5,linetype="dashed")+
  scale_x_discrete(limits=pos.group)+
  theme(legend.position = "right")+
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("white","gray","white","gray","white","gray"))+
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size=12))

```

#Study 2: Voluntary Positive and Negative Reciprocity

## Cleaning Data

```{r}

#reshape Study 2 data
study2_data_long <- reshape(study2_data, 
varying = c("Initial_Trial_Kept_DidntSteal_Sticker",
            "Initial_Trial_Direct_Reciprocity",
            "Initial_Trial_GaveToSameSide",
            "Initial_Trial_MemCheck_Receiving_Correct",
            "Initial_Trial_MemCheck_Giving_Correct",
            "InGroup_Trial_Kept_DidntSteal_Sticker",
            "InGroup_Trial_Direct_Reciprocity",
            "InGroup_Trial_Group_Reciprocity",
            "InGroup_Trial_MemCheck_Receiving_Correct",
            "InGroup_Trial_MemCheck_Giving_Correct",
            "OutGroup_Trial_Kept_DidntSteal_Sticker",
            "OutGroup_Trial_Direct_Reciprocity",
            "OutGroup_Trial_Group_Reciprocity",
            "OutGroup_Trial_MemCheck_Receiving_Correct",
            "OutGroup_Trial_MemCheck_Giving_Correct",
            "Perceptual_Control_Trial_Kept_DidntSteal_Sticker",
            "Perceptual_Control_Trial_Direct_Reciprocity",
            "Perceptual_Control_Trial_Group_Reciprocity",
            "Perceptual_Control_Trial_MemCheck_Receiving_Correct",
            "Perceptual_Control_Trial_MemCheck_Giving_Correct"),
v.names = c("0_Kept_DidntSteal_Sticker",
            "1_Direct Reciprocity",
            "2_Group Reciprocity",
            "3_Memory Check Receiving Q Correct",
            "4_Memory Check Giving Q Correct"),
timevar="Trial Type",
times = c("Initial Trial","In Group Trial","Out Group Trial","Perceptual Control Trial"),
new.row.names = 1:800,
direction = "long")

#adding columns to denote whether the child gave to the in-group
study2_data_long$Gave_To_InGroup <- NA
study2_data_long$Gave_To_InGroup[study2_data_long$`Trial Type` == "In Group Trial" & study2_data_long$`2_Group Reciprocity`==1] <- 1
study2_data_long$Gave_To_InGroup[study2_data_long$`Trial Type` == "In Group Trial" & study2_data_long$`2_Group Reciprocity`==0] <- 0
study2_data_long$Gave_To_InGroup[study2_data_long$`Trial Type` == "Out Group Trial" & study2_data_long$`2_Group Reciprocity`==1] <- 0
study2_data_long$Gave_To_InGroup[study2_data_long$`Trial Type` == "Out Group Trial" & study2_data_long$`2_Group Reciprocity`==0] <- 1

#getting rid of initial trial
study2_data_long$`2_Group Reciprocity`[study2_data_long$`Trial Type` == 'Initial Trial'] <- NA

```

## Descriptive Analyses
```{r}
#descriptive analyses
study2_mean_age <- mean(study2_data$Age)
study2_min_age <- min(study2_data$Age)
study2_max_age <- max(study2_data$Age)

#creating a table for gender
study2_gender <- data.frame(table(study2_data$Gender))
```

Gender Distribution:
`r study2_gender`


## Overall Giving and Stealing:

We first investigated the rate of reciprocity (did children give away or keep the sticker?)

On how many trials did children choose to keep the sticker for themselves?
```{r}

#subsetting data into giving condition
study2_data_long_giving <-subset(study2_data_long,Condition=="Giving")
study2_data_long_stealing <- subset(study2_data_long,Condition=="Stealing")

#rates of giving and stealing stickers
study2.overall.giving.rate <- length(which(study2_data_long_giving$`0_Kept_DidntSteal_Sticker`==0))

study2.overall.stealing.rate <-length(which(study2_data_long_stealing$`0_Kept_DidntSteal_Sticker`==0))

study2.totaltrials.giving <- length(which(study2_data_long_giving$`0_Kept_DidntSteal_Sticker`<2))
study2.totaltrials.stealing <- length(which(study2_data_long_stealing$`0_Kept_DidntSteal_Sticker`<2))
```

Children chose to give away their stickers on a total of `r study2.overall.giving.rate` trials out of `r study2.totaltrials.giving` (`r study2.overall.giving.rate/study2.totaltrials.giving*100` %)

Children chose to steal stickers on a total of `r study2.overall.stealing.rate` trials out of `r study2.totaltrials.stealing` (`r study2.overall.stealing.rate/study2.totaltrials.stealing*100` %)


We first investigated factors that affected overall giving and stealing:

```{r}
m1.study2 <- glmer(study2_data_long$`0_Kept_DidntSteal_Sticker` ~ 
                   Age+ 
                   relevel(factor(`Trial Type`),"Initial Trial")+ 
                   Condition+ 
                   (1|`Subject ID`),
                   study2_data_long,
                   family="binomial")

kable(tidy(m1.study2,digits=3))

m1.study2.overall <- Anova(m1.study2,test="Chisq")
kable(m1.study2.overall,digits=3)
```


Note that intitial analyses showed no Condition x Age effects, though very few children refused to steal stickers, suggesting we may be limited in unconvering any age effects.

## Direct Reciprocity

We next investigated factors that impact direct reciprocity:

```{r}
#running the model
m2.study2 <- update(m1.study1,.~.,data=study2_data_long)

#printing tables
kable(tidy(m2.study2,digits=3))

m2.study2.overall <-Anova(m2.study2,test="Chisq")
kable(m2.study2.overall,digits=3)

```

We then compared direct reciprocity to chance for each trial:

```{r}

#Subsetting Data
study2_data_giving <- subset(study2_data,Condition=="Giving")
study2_data_stealing <- subset(study2_data,Condition=="Stealing")

#Initial Trial: Giving
study2.initial.trial.giving <- binom.test(
  length(which(study2_data_giving$Initial_Trial_Direct_Reciprocity==1)),
  length(which(study2_data_giving$Initial_Trial_Direct_Reciprocity<2)),p=.25)

#Initial Trial: Stealing
study2.initial.trial.stealing <- binom.test(
  length(which(study2_data_stealing$Initial_Trial_Direct_Reciprocity==1)),
  length(which(study2_data_stealing$Initial_Trial_Direct_Reciprocity<2)),p=.25)

#In Group Trial: Giving
study2.ingroup.trial.giving <- binom.test(
  length(which(study2_data_giving$InGroup_Trial_Direct_Reciprocity==1)),
  length(which(study2_data_giving$InGroup_Trial_Direct_Reciprocity<2)),p=.25)

#In Group Trial: Stealing
study2.ingroup.trial.stealing <- binom.test(
  length(which(study2_data_stealing$InGroup_Trial_Direct_Reciprocity==1)),
  length(which(study2_data_stealing$InGroup_Trial_Direct_Reciprocity<2)),p=.25)

#Out Group Trial: Giving
study2.outgroup.trial.giving <- binom.test(
  length(which(study2_data_giving$OutGroup_Trial_Direct_Reciprocity==1)),
  length(which(study2_data_giving$OutGroup_Trial_Direct_Reciprocity<2)),p=.25)

#Out Group Trial: Stealing
study2.outgroup.trial.stealing <- binom.test(
  length(which(study2_data_stealing$OutGroup_Trial_Direct_Reciprocity==1)),
  length(which(study2_data_stealing$OutGroup_Trial_Direct_Reciprocity<2)),p=.25)

#Perceptual Control Group Trial: Giving
study2.perceptcntrl.trial.giving <- binom.test(
  length(which(study2_data_giving$Perceptual_Control_Trial_Direct_Reciprocity==1)),
  length(which(study2_data_giving$Perceptual_Control_Trial_Direct_Reciprocity<2)),p=.25)

#Perceptual Control Group Trial: Stealing
study2.perceptcntrl.trial.stealing <- binom.test(
  length(which(study2_data_stealing$Perceptual_Control_Trial_Direct_Reciprocity==1)),
  length(which(study2_data_stealing$Perceptual_Control_Trial_Direct_Reciprocity<2)),p=.25)

#Overall binomial
study2.overall.giving <-binom.test(
  length(which(study2_data_long_giving$`1_Direct Reciprocity`==1)),
  length(which(study2_data_long_giving$`1_Direct Reciprocity`<2)),p=.25)

study2.overall.stealing <-binom.test(
  length(which(study2_data_long_stealing$`1_Direct Reciprocity`==1)),
  length(which(study2_data_long_stealing$`1_Direct Reciprocity`<2)),p=.25)


#Printing Tables of Binomial Tests
study2.initial.trial.giving.1 <- tidy(study2.initial.trial.giving,digits=3)
study2.initial.trial.giving.1$test <- "initial trial, giving - direct reciprocity"
study2.initial.trial.stealing.1 <- tidy(study2.initial.trial.stealing,digits=3)
study2.initial.trial.stealing.1$test <- "initial trial, stealing - direct reciprocity"
study2.ingroup.trial.giving.1 <- tidy(study2.ingroup.trial.giving,digits=3)
study2.ingroup.trial.giving.1$test <- "ingroup trial, giving - direct reciprocity"
study2.ingroup.trial.stealing.1 <- tidy(study2.ingroup.trial.stealing,digits=3)
study2.ingroup.trial.stealing.1$test <- "ingroup trial, stealing - direct reciprocity"
study2.outgroup.trial.giving.1 <- tidy(study2.outgroup.trial.giving,digits=3)
study2.outgroup.trial.giving.1$test <- "outgroup trial, giving - direct reciprocity"
study2.outgroup.trial.stealing.1 <- tidy(study2.outgroup.trial.stealing,digits=3)
study2.outgroup.trial.stealing.1$test <- "outgroup trial, stealing - direct reciprocity"
study2.perceptcntrl.trial.giving.1 <- tidy(study2.perceptcntrl.trial.giving,digits=3)
study2.perceptcntrl.trial.giving.1$test <- "perceptual similarity control trial, giving - individual reciprocity"
study2.perceptcntrl.trial.stealing.1 <- tidy(study2.perceptcntrl.trial.stealing,digits=3)
study2.perceptcntrl.trial.stealing.1$test <- "perceptual similarity control trial, stealing - individual reciprocity"
study2.overall.giving.1 <- tidy(study2.overall.giving,digits=3)
study2.overall.giving.1$test <- "overall, giving - individual reciprocity"
study2.overall.stealing.1 <- tidy(study2.overall.stealing,digits=3)
study2.overall.stealing.1$test <- "overall, stealing - individual reciprocity"

#binding the table of tests together
study2.total.direct.reciprocity <- rbind(study2.initial.trial.giving.1,
                                             study2.initial.trial.stealing.1,
                                             study2.ingroup.trial.giving.1,
                                             study2.ingroup.trial.stealing.1,
                                             study2.outgroup.trial.giving.1,
                                             study2.outgroup.trial.stealing.1,
                                             study2.perceptcntrl.trial.giving.1,
                                             study2.perceptcntrl.trial.stealing.1,
                                             study2.overall.giving.1,
                                             study2.overall.stealing.1)

#deleting unnecessary information
study2.total.direct.reciprocity$method <- NULL
study2.total.direct.reciprocity$alternative <-NULL

#creating a table of direct reciprocity
study2.direct.reciprocity.table.giving <- tapply(
  study2_data_long_giving$`1_Direct Reciprocity`,
  study2_data_long_giving$`Trial Type`,
  mean,na.rm=TRUE)

study2.direct.reciprocity.table.stealing <-tapply(study2_data_long_stealing$`1_Direct Reciprocity`,
                                                     study2_data_long_stealing$`Trial Type`,
                                                     mean,na.rm=TRUE)

```


```{r}
study2.direct.recip.table.giving.melted$Condition <- "giving"
study2.direct.recip.table.stealing.melted <- melt(study2.direct.recip.table.stealing)
study2.direct.recip.table.stealing.melted$Condition <- "stealing"

study2.direct.recip.table <- rbind(study2.direct.recip.table.giving.melted,
                                       study2.direct.recip.table.stealing.melted)

#creating a table of group level reciprocity
study2.group.recip.table.giving <-tapply(study2_data_long_giving$`2_Group Reciprocity`,
                                         study2_data_long_giving$`Trial Type`,
                                         mean,
                                         na.rm=TRUE)
study2.group.recip.table.stealing <-tapply(study2_data_long_stealing$`2_Group Reciprocity`,
                                           study2_data_long_stealing$`Trial Type`,
                                           mean,
                                           na.rm=TRUE)

#getting rid of the baseline trial
study2.group.recip.table.giving$`Initial Trial` <- NULL
study2.group.recip.table.stealing$`Initial Trial` <- NULL

#melting the table
study2.group.recip.table.giving.melted <- melt(study2.group.recip.table.giving)
study2.group.recip.table.giving.melted$Condition <- "giving"
study2.group.recip.table.stealing.melted <- melt(study2.group.recip.table.stealing)
study2.group.recip.table.stealing.melted$Condition <- "stealing"

study2.group.recip.table <- rbind(study2.group.recip.table.giving.melted,study2.group.recip.table.stealing.melted)


#creating bargraphs

#creating data frame with coordinates
label.sig <- data.frame(Group=c("Initial\nTrial","In Group\nTrial", "Out Group\nTrial", "Perceptual Similarity\nTrial"),
                        Value=c(.5,.5,.5,.5),
                        Label=c("*","**","",""))

#direct reciprocity graph
study2.direct.recip.plot <- ggplot(study2.direct.recip.table, 
                                       aes(x=Var1,y=value,fill=Condition))+
  geom_bar(stat="identity",colour="black",
           position=position_dodge())+
  theme_minimal(base_family='Helvetica')+
  scale_y_continuous(labels=scales::percent,limits=c(0,1))+
  labs(x="Trial Type",y="Proportion of Children Displaying\nDirect Reciprocity")+
  geom_hline(yintercept=.25,linetype="dashed")+
  scale_x_discrete(limits=pos.indiv, labels=pos.indiv.2)+
  theme(legend.position = "right")+
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("white","gray","white","gray","white","gray","white","gray"))+
  ggtitle("Study 2: Direct Reciprocity")+
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size=12))

#group reciprocity graph
study2.group.recip.plot <- ggplot(study2.group.recip.table, aes(x=L1,y=value,fill=Condition))+geom_bar(stat="identity",colour="black",
          position=position_dodge())+
  scale_y_continuous(labels=scales::percent,limits=c(0,1))+
  labs(x="Trial Type",y="Proportion of Children Displaying\nGroup-Based Reciprocity")+
  ggtitle("Study 2: Group Reciprocity")+
  geom_hline(yintercept=.5,linetype="dashed")+
  scale_x_discrete(limits=pos.group)+
  theme(legend.position = "right")+
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("white","gray","white","gray","white","gray"))+
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size=12))


```

Proportion of Children Engaging in Direct Reciprocity in Study 2:

```{r}
print(study2.direct.recip.plot)
```

Proportion of Children Engaging in Group Reciprocity in Study 2:
```{r}

```

```{r}
#adding whether children gave to the ingroup
study3_data_long$Gave_To_InGroup <- NA
```

## Overall Giving Rates

We first investigated the rate of reciprocity (did children give away the sticker?)

Social Reciprocity Rates in Study 3:

On how many trials did children choose to keep the sticker for themselves?
```{r}
study3.overallrecip.rate <- length(which(study3_data_long$`0_GaveStickerAway`==1))
study3.totaltrials <- length(which(study3_data_long$`0_GaveStickerAway`<2))
```

Children chose to give away their stickers on a total of `r study3.overallrecip.rate` trials out of `r study3.totaltrials` (`r study3.overallrecip.rate/study3.totaltrials*100` %).


We next investigated factors that affect giving rates:

```{r}

m1.study3 <- glmer(study3_data_long$`0_GaveStickerAway` ~ 
                   Age + 
                   relevel(factor(GroupType),"Food")+
                   InGroupTrial+
                   (1|`Subject ID`),
                 study3_data_long,
                 family="binomial")

kable(tidy(m1.study3,digits=3))

m1.study3.overall <-Anova(m1.study3,test="Chisq")
kable(tidy(m1.study3.overall,digits=3))
```

## Direct Reciprocity

We investigated factors that impact direct reciprocity:
```{r}

m2.study3 <- glmer(study3_data_long$`1_Direct Reciprocity` ~ 
                   Age + 
                   relevel(factor(GroupType),"Food")+
                   InGroupTrial+
                   (1|`Subject ID`),
                 study3_data_long,
                 family="binomial")

kable(tidy(m2.study3),digits=3)

m2.study3.overall <- Anova(m2.study3, test="Chisq")

kable(m2.study3.overall,digits=3)
```

```{r}
#Country InGroup Trial

  length(which(study3_data$Country_InGroup_Direct_Reciprocity==1)),
  length(which(study3_data$Country_InGroup_Direct_Reciprocity<2)),p=.25)

#Country OutGroup Trial

  length(which(study3_data$Country_OutGroup_Direct_Reciprocity==1)),
  length(which(study3_data$Country_OutGroup_Direct_Reciprocity<2)),p=.25)


#Food InGroup Trial
study3.food.ingroup <- binom.test(
  length(which(study3_data$Food_InGroup_Direct_Reciprocity==1)),
  length(which(study3_data$Food_InGroup_Direct_Reciprocity<2)),p=.25)

#Food OutGroup Trial

  length(which(study3_data$Food_OutGroup_Direct_Reciprocity==1)),
  length(which(study3_data$Food_OutGroup_Direct_Reciprocity<2)),p=.25)


#Overall binomial
study3.overall.direct.reciprocity.binomial <-binom.test(
  length(which(study3_data_long$`1_Direct Reciprocity`==1)),
  length(which(study3_data_long$`1_Direct Reciprocity`<2)),p=.25)


#Printing Tables of Binomial Tests
study3.gender.ingroup.1 <- tidy(study3.gender.ingroup,digits=3)

study3.gender.outgroup.1 <- tidy(study3.gender.outgroup,digits=3)

study3.country.ingroup.1 <- tidy(study3.country.ingroup,digits=3)

study3.country.outgroup.1 <- tidy(study3.country.outgroup,digits=3)

study3.food.outgroup.1 <- tidy(study3.food.outgroup,digits=3)
study3.food.outgroup.1$test <- "food outgroup - direct reciprocity"

study3.overall.direct.reciprocity.binomial.1$test <- "overall direct reciprocity"

#binding tables together
study3.total.direct.reciprocity <- rbind(study3.gender.ingroup.1,
                                             study3.gender.outgroup.1,
                                             study3.country.ingroup.1,
                                             study3.country.outgroup.1,
                                             study3.food.ingroup.1,

#deleting unnecessary information

study3.total.direct.reciprocity$alternative <-NULL
```

# Study 4: Positive Direct Reciprocity Norms


## Cleaning Data

```{r}

#reshape study 4 data
study4_data_long <- reshape(study4_data, 
varying = c("Receiving Trial(Child Receives)_Direct_Reciprocity",
            "Receiving_Trial_Explanation",
            "Receiving Trial (Child Receives)_MemCheck_Correct",
            "Giving Trial (Child Gives)_Direct_Reciprocity",
            "Giving_Trial_Explanation",
            "Giving Trial (Child Gives)_MemCheck_Correct"),
v.names = c("1_Direct Reciprocity","2_Explanation","3_Mem_Check_Correct"),
timevar="Trial Type",
times = c("Receiving Trial (Self Norm)","Giving Trial (Other Norm)"),
new.row.names = 1:400,
direction = "long")

```


## Descriptive Analyses

```{r}
#descriptive analyses
study4_mean_age <- mean(study4_data$Age)
study4_min_age <- min(study4_data$Age)
study4_max_age <- max(study4_data$Age)

#creating a table for gender
study4_gender <- data.frame(table(study4_data$Gender))

```
Age Distribution:
Mean age: `r study4_mean_age`; Range = `r study4_min_age` to `r study4_max_age`.

Gender Distribution:
`r study4_gender`


## Direct Reciprocity

We first investigated factors that influence rates of direct reciprocity as a norm:
```{r}
m1.study4 <- glmer(`1_Direct Reciprocity` ~ 
                   Age + 
                   `Trial Type` +
                   (1|`SubjectID`),
                 study4_data_long,
                 family="binomial")
#printing tables
kable(tidy(m1.study4,digits=3))

m1.study4.overall <- Anova(m1.study4,test="Chisq")
kable(m1.study4.overall,digits=3)
```

Comparing Rates of Direct Reciprocity to Chance:

```{r}

#Receiving Trial
study4.receiving.trial <- binom.test(
  sum(study4_data$`Receiving Trial(Child Receives)_Direct_Reciprocity`==1),
  sum(study4_data$`Receiving Trial(Child Receives)_Direct_Reciprocity`<2),p=.25)

#Giving Trial
study4.giving.trial <- binom.test(
  sum(study4_data$`Giving Trial (Child Gives)_Direct_Reciprocity`),
  sum(study4_data$`Giving Trial (Child Gives)_Direct_Reciprocity`<2),p=.25)


#Overall binomial
study4.overall <-binom.test(
  length(which(study4_data_long$`1_Direct Reciprocity`==1)),
  length(which(study4_data_long$`1_Direct Reciprocity`<2)),p=.25)


#Printing Tables of Binomial Tests
study4.receiving.trial.1 <- tidy(study4.receiving.trial)
study4.receiving.trial.1$test <- "Receiving Trial (Self Norm)"
study4.giving.trial.1 <- tidy(study4.giving.trial)
study4.giving.trial.1$test <- "Receiving Trial (Other Norm)"
study4.overall.1 <- tidy(study4.overall)
study4.overall.1$test <- "Overall"

#binding tables together
study4.total.direct.reciprocity <- rbind(study4.receiving.trial.1,
                                         study4.giving.trial.1,
                                         study4.overall.1)

#removing unnecessary information
study4.total.direct.reciprocity$method <- NULL
study4.total.direct.reciprocity$alternative <-NULL
```

## Memory Check Quetions:

Memory Check Questions confirmed that most children remember the benefactor and beneficiary
```{r}

#subsetting data according to giving vs. receiving trial

study4_data_giving <- subset(study4_data_long,study4_data_long$`Trial Type`=="Receiving Trial (Self Norm)")
study4_data_receiving <- subset(study4_data_long,study4_data_long$`Trial Type`=="Giving Trial (Other Norm)")

#giving trial memory check question:
study4.memcheck.overall.giving <- binom.test(
  length(which(study4_data_giving$`3_Mem_Check_Correct`==1)),
  length(which(study4_data_giving$`3_Mem_Check_Correct`<2)))

#receiving trial memory check question:
study4.memcheck.overall.receiving <- binom.test(
  length(which(study4_data_receiving$`3_Mem_Check_Correct`==1)),
  length(which(study4_data_receiving$`3_Mem_Check_Correct`<2)))

```

Binomial test for all receiving memory check questions in Study 4:
```{r}
tidy(study4.memcheck.overall.receiving)
```
Binomial test for all giving memory check questions in Study 4:
```{r}
tidy(study4.memcheck.overall.giving)
```


We also checked to make sure that the main model results held even when considering only children who answered both memory check questions correctly:

```{r}
#creating a subset of children with correct responses to memory check questions only
study4_data_long_corrmem <- subset(study4_data_long,
                                   study4_data_long$`3_Mem_Check_Correct`==1)

#re-doing main analysis only with children who correctly recalled benefactors and beneficiaries

m2.study4 <- update(m1.study4, .~., data=study4_data_long_corrmem)

#print tables
kable(tidy(m2.study4,digits=3))

m2.study4.overall <-Anova(m2.study4,test="Chisq")
kable(tidy(m2.study4.overall,digits=3))


```

## Direct Reciprocity

We first investigated factors that impact direct reciprocity:
```{r}

#note: model didn't initially converge without switching optimizers
m1.study5 <- glmer(study5_data_long$`1_Direct Reciprocity` ~ 
                   Age + 
                   Condition +
                   InGroupTrial+
                   relevel(factor(GroupType),"Food")+
                   (1|`Subject ID`),
                 study5_data_long,
                 family="binomial",
                 control=glmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa",optCtrl=list(maxfun=100000)))

#printing tables

kable(tidy(m1.study5),digits=3)
m1.study5.overall <- Anova(m1.study5,test="Chisq")
kable(m1.study5.overall,digits=3)
```

```{r}
#Overall Receiving Question
study5.memcheck.overall.receiving <- binom.test(
  length(which(study5_data_long$`3_Memory Check Receiving Q Correct`==1)),
```

We also checked to make sure that the main model results held even when considering only children who answered both memory check questions correctly:
```{r}

#creating a subset of children with correct responses to memory check questions only

#changing dataset
m2.study5 <- glmer(study5_data_long_corrmem$`1_Direct Reciprocity` ~ 
                   Age+
                   Condition+
                   InGroupTrial+
                   relevel(factor(GroupType),"Food")+
                   (1|`Subject ID`),
                 study5_data_long_corrmem,
                 family="binomial")

#print data
summary(m2.study5)
m2.study5.overall <-Anova(m2.study5,test="Chisq")
kable(m2.study5.overall,digits=3)
```

## Negative Direct & Group Reciprocity

```{r}
#direct reciprocity
#adding all instances of the behavior
direct.neg.reciprocity.total <- sum(
  (length(which(study1b_data_long$`1_Direct Reciprocity`==1)))+
(length(which(study2_data_long_stealing$`1_Direct Reciprocity`==1))))

#gathering total sample size
direct.neg.reciprocity.length <- sum(
  (length(which(study1b_data_long$`1_Direct Reciprocity`<2)))+
(length(which(study2_data_long_stealing$`1_Direct Reciprocity`<2))))

#binomial test
overall.neg.direct.recip.binomial <- binom.test(direct.neg.reciprocity.total,direct.neg.reciprocity.length,.25)

#printing table
overall.neg.direct.recip.binomial$type <- "Negative Reciprocity: Direct"
overall.neg.direct.recip.binomial.table <- tidy(overall.neg.direct.recip.binomial)

#group reciprocity
#adding all instances of the behavior
group.neg.reciprocity.total <- length(which(study1b_data_long$`2_Group Reciprocity`==1))+
(length(which(study2_data_long_stealing$`2_Group Reciprocity`==1)))

#gathering total sample siaze
group.neg.reciprocity.total.length <-(length(which(study1b_data_long$`2_Group Reciprocity`<2))+length(which(study2_data_long_stealing$`2_Group Reciprocity`<2)))


#binomial test
overall.neg.group.recip.binomial <- binom.test(group.neg.reciprocity.total,group.neg.reciprocity.total.length,.5)

#printing table
overall.neg.group.recip.binomial$type <- "Negative Reciprocity: Group"
overall.neg.group.recip.binomial.table <- tidy(overall.neg.group.recip.binomial,digits=3)

#checking for overall punishment of the group member that was not the malefactor

#subsetting data into those who did not give to the malefactor
study1b_data_long_no_malefactor <- subset(study1b_data_long,study1b_data_long$`1_Direct Reciprocity`==0)
study2_data_long_stealing_no_malefactor <- subset(study2_data_long_stealing,study2_data_long_stealing$`1_Direct Reciprocity`==0)


#adding up all instances of the behavior: gathering those who gave to the non-malefactor
overall.neg.direct.nonmalefactor <- sum(length(which(study1b_data_long_no_malefactor$`2_Group Reciprocity`==1))+
                                          length(which(study2_data_long_stealing_no_malefactor$`2_Group Reciprocity`==1)))

#gathering new sample size (deleting out those who gave to the malefactor)
overall.neg.direct.nonmalefactor.length <- length(which(study1b_data_long_no_malefactor$`Subject ID`>0))+
  length(which(study2_data_long_stealing_no_malefactor$`Subject ID`>0))

#binomial test
overall.neg.direct.nonmalefactor.binomial <- binom.test(overall.neg.direct.nonmalefactor,overall.neg.direct.nonmalefactor.length,.33)

#printing table
overall.neg.direct.nonmalefactor.binomial$type <- "Negative Reciprocity: Non-Malefactor"
overall.neg.direct.nonmalefactor.binomial.table <-tidy(overall.neg.direct.nonmalefactor.binomial)

```

## Bayes Factors Results

```{r}
#The following is output pasted from http://pcl.missouri.edu/bf-binomial:
  
##Positive Direct Reciprocity

#Input is: 
#Successes = 175 
#Trials = 625 
#Null Point = 0.25 
#Prior (a,b) = ( 1 , 1 ) 

#Output are odds of Null Model over Alternative Model: 
#Bayes Factor = 5.150637
positive.direct.bf.null <- 5.150637


## Negative Direct Reciprocity

#Input is: 
#Successes = 135 
#Trials = 309 
#Null Point = 0.25 
#Prior (a,b) = ( 1 , 1 ) 

#Output are odds of Null Model over Alternative Model: 
#Bayes Factor = 1.203798e-10 
negative.direct.bf.null <- 1.203798e-10

## Transform Bayes Factor into Alternative overall Null:
neg.direct.bf.alternative <- 1/1.20379e-10

##Positive Group Reciprocity

#Input is: 
#Successes = 301 
#Trials = 563 
#Null Point = 0.5 
#Prior (a,b) = ( 1 , 1 ) 

#Output are odds of Null Model over Alternative Model: 
#Bayes Factor = 4.917005 
positive.group.bf.null <- 4.917005

##Negative Group Reciprocity

#Input is: 
#Successes = 179 
#Trials = 271 
#Null Point = 0.5 
#Prior (a,b) = ( 1 , 1 ) 

#Output are odds of Null Model over Alternative Model: 
#Bayes Factor = 9.323039e-06 
negative.group.bf.null <- 9.323039e-06
negative.group.bf.alternative <- 1/negative.group.bf.null

## Negative Reciprocity without the Malefactor

#Input is: 
#Successes = 62 
#Trials = 174 
#Null Point = 0.33 
#Prior (a,b) = ( 1 , 1 ) 

#Output are odds of Null Model over Alternative Model: 
#Bayes Factor = 8.429991
negative.group.nonmalefactor.bf.null <- 8.429991

## In-Group Bias

#Input is: 
#Successes = 487 
#Trials = 864 
#Null Point = 0.5 
#Prior (a,b) = ( 1 , 1 ) 

#Output are odds of Null Model over Alternative Model: 
#Bayes Factor = 0.02112436 
ingroup.bias.bf.null <- 0.02112436
ingroup.bias.bf.alternative <- 1/ingroup.bias.bf.null

## Creating a Table with these values

BFTable <- rbind(positive.direct.bf.null,positive.group.bf.null,negative.direct.bf.null,negative.group.bf.null,negative.group.nonmalefactor.bf.null,ingroup.bias.bf.null)

colnames(BFTable) <- "Null_over_Alternative"

BFTable.dataframe <- as.data.frame(BFTable)

BFTable.dataframe$`Alternative_over_Null` <- 1/BFTable.dataframe$Null_over_Alternative

print(BFTable.dataframe)
kable(BFTable.dataframe,digits=3)


```

# Supplementary Analyses

## Full Models, w/ Interaction Effects

### Direct Reciprocity

Study 1:
```{r}

direct.study1.full <- glmer(`1_Direct Reciprocity` ~ 
                   Age + 
                   relevel(factor(`Trial Type`),"Initial Trial") + 
                   Condition + 
                   (1|`Subject ID`) +
                   Condition:relevel(factor(`Trial Type`),"Initial Trial")+
                   Condition:Age+
                   Age:relevel(factor(`Trial Type`),"Initial Trial")+
                   Age:relevel(factor(`Trial Type`),"Initial Trial"):Condition,
                 study1_data_long,
                 family="binomial")

#print model estimates
summary(direct.study1.full)
kable(tidy(direct.study1.full,digits=3))

#print chi-squared tests for factors in model
direct.study1.full.overall <-Anova(direct.study1.full,test="Chisq")
kable(direct.study1.full.overall,digits=3)
```

Exploring the Age x Condition X Trial Type Interaction
```{r}

study1.age.trialtype.interxn <- ggplot(study1_data_long) + 
  aes(x=Age, y=`1_Direct Reciprocity`) + 
  geom_smooth(method="glm", method.args=list(family="binomial")) + 
  facet_grid(`Trial Type`~Condition)+
  theme_minimal()+
  labs(y="Proportion Displaying \n Direct Reciprocity",x="Age")+
  scale_y_continuous()

study1.age.trialtype.interxn


```
In the Stealing Condition, children increase their rates of direct reciprocity, except for in the Initial Trial. Since the effect was overall below our pre-defined significance levels for exploratory interaction effects, we do not offer a richer interpretation, but include the figure for completeness


```{r}
#running model w/ new optimizer to check conclusions given the warning:
direct.study1.full.update <- glmer(`1_Direct Reciprocity` ~ 
                   Age + 
                   relevel(factor(`Trial Type`),"Initial Trial") + 
                   Condition + 
                   (1|`Subject ID`) +
                   Condition:relevel(factor(`Trial Type`),"Initial Trial")+
                   Condition:Age+
                   Age:relevel(factor(`Trial Type`),"Initial Trial")+
                   Age:relevel(factor(`Trial Type`),"Initial Trial"):Condition,
                 study1_data_long,
                 family="binomial",
                 control=glmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa",optCtrl=list(maxfun=100000)))

direct.study1.full.overall.update <-Anova(direct.study1.full.update,test="Chisq")
kable(direct.study1.full.overall.update,digits=3)
```
